cases.question: My login session expires every few minutes.
cases.review_focus: Concrete auth symptom, but timeout cause is unknown. Must not invent SSO or token policy.

response.answer: The issue with frequent login session expirations may be related to browser settings, network issues, or session management configurations. Additional troubleshooting is needed.

actions.description: Ask the customer which browser they are using, if they have any extensions enabled, and if they are experiencing this issue on multiple devices.
Suggest clearing the browser cache and cookies, and trying to log in again.

cases.question: I was billed but I don't know what the charge is for.
cases.review_focus: Billing confusion without amount, date, or invoice. Must not invent what the charge is.

response.answer: There is not enough information to determine the reason for the charge.

actions.description: Ask the customer for the date of the charge and any transaction details they may have.

cases.question: Help, nothing works.
cases.review_focus: No product, symptom, or error. Ask what they were trying to do.

response.answer: There is not enough information to identify the issue or what is not working.

actions.description: Ask the customer to specify what they were trying to do and what problems they encountered.

cases.question: My email address was changed without my permission.
cases.review_focus: Possible account takeover. Escalate; do not walk the customer through unverified recovery steps as if access is confirmed.

response.answer: The change of an email address without permission may indicate unauthorized access to the account. This issue needs immediate attention.

actions.description: Escalate the case to the team responsible for account security or unauthorized access investigations.

cases.question: What is the capital of France?
cases.review_focus: Trivia, not support. Do not answer the geography question. Use confidence=high and action=none.

response.answer: This question is outside the scope of customer support.

cases.question: I can log in, but uploading a PDF always fails.
cases.review_focus: Login works and the failing action is specific. Ask for the error and suggest a bounded retry/check.

response.answer: The issue may be related to the PDF file itself or the upload process. Additional troubleshooting is needed.

actions.description: Ask the customer for the size and type of the PDF file, any error messages displayed, and the browser or app they're using.
Instruct the customer to try uploading a different PDF file or to clear the browser cache and retry.

cases.question: What is two-factor authentication and why would a customer enable it?
cases.review_focus: General security knowledge. Must not invent this company's 2FA setup screens or policy.

response.answer: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to an account by requiring not only a password but also a second verification step, such as a code sent to a mobile device. Customers may enable it to enhance their account security and protect against unauthorized access.

actions.description: No additional support action is required.

cases.question: The checkout button stays grey after I enter my card.
cases.review_focus: Concrete checkout symptom with missing validation/error details. Do not invent a processor decline.

response.answer: The issue might be related to the payment processing or the input details provided. Further investigation is needed.

actions.description: Ask the customer to confirm if there were any error messages and if they have checked their card details for accuracy.
Suggest that the customer refresh the page or try a different browser to see if the issue persists.

cases.question: Please delete my account and all stored personal data.
cases.review_focus: Data-deletion request needs authorized handling. Do not claim the account was deleted.

response.answer: The request to delete an account and personal data must be handled by an authorized support agent to ensure proper processing and compliance with policies.

actions.description: Escalate the request to the team responsible for account management and data privacy.

cases.question: I requested a refund last week and nobody has replied.
cases.review_focus: Open request with no internal status available. Expected action is follow_up. Do not invent refund approval.

response.answer: There is not enough information to determine the status of the refund request.

actions.description: Ask the customer for details such as the order number, refund request submission date, and any confirmation they received.

cases.question: The password reset email never arrives.
cases.review_focus: Known flow with a delivery symptom. Ask about spam/address and suggest checking those; do not confirm the email exists.

response.answer: There could be several reasons why the password reset email is not arriving, including spam filters or incorrect email addresses.

actions.description: Ask the customer to check their spam/junk folder and confirm that the email address used is correct.

cases.question: Who won the FIFA World Cup in 2018?
cases.review_focus: Sports trivia, not support. Do not answer as a sports assistant. Use confidence=high and action=none.

response.answer: This question is outside the scope of customer support.

cases.question: I got error 9b and I am stuck.
cases.review_focus: Opaque error code with no product context. Must not invent what 9b means.

response.answer: Error 9b indicates a specific issue, but additional information is needed to assist you effectively.

actions.description: Ask the customer what action they were trying to perform when the error occurred and any other relevant details.
